sections.text:
Inspect all system components and 
 correct malfunction make sure all valve are in their proper position and suction and discharge line are open

Shut down immediately. 
 Imo Pump are unidirectional and extended reverse rotation can cause damage. 
 Reveres the direction of the driver
Loss of prime or Boost pressure

Shut down the pump repine the pump and restart repeat until pump primes. 
 Check boost system for malfunction
Symptoms are form in the fluid and noise. Reseal and tighten all joints in suction line
May be accompanied by noise and air in the fluid fill reservoir to proper level be sure intake is for enough below the minimum fluid level to prevent vortex

 shaft, failed pump, may be accompanied by noise or vibration locate and correct cause
Check for leak in suction line low fluid level vortex at inlet to suction line, or return lines above fluid level

Realign the pump. Misalignment 
 may also be caused be temperature variation
Loose or mis-positioned coupling broken shaft, bad bearing
Reduce viscosity by temperature control of fluid

Checks for blockage of 
 discharge line from the pump
